title: HELIX Template: PeopleSoft Chartfield to Workday Worktag Conversion Rules
description: Executable-style ruleset that converts a PeopleSoft FSCM chartfield string into a Workday Ledger Account plus worktag set, routed through the HELIX canonical codes. Pair with the crosswalks in bridge/xref/ps-to-workday-fin/. Evaluate rules in ascending priority; later rules add worktags, they never overwrite Company or Ledger Account.

rules.rationale: Every PS GL business unit resolves to exactly one Workday Company. Company is the balancing entity.
Natural account maps to a Workday Ledger Account through the HELIX account taxonomy.
Workday separates the ledger account from its revenue category. One PS revenue account often becomes a coarser ledger account plus a category worktag.
Expense detail moves from the account string into a Spend Category worktag.
Balance-sheet accounts carry no revenue or spend category.
Fund maps directly to the Workday Fund worktag; restriction class travels with it (helix/fund-type).

when.condition: helix fund-type in (endowment, quasi_endowment, temporarily_restricted, permanently_restricted) AND gift-funded

rules.rationale: Restricted gift funds need a Gift worktag in Workday to track donor intent and stewardship.
DEPTID becomes the Cost Center. Supervisory Organization is built separately from the HCM REPORTS_TO tree (see bridge/xref/ps-to-workday-hr/position-xref.json).
Program carries NACUBO/IPEDS functional classification (instruction, research, public service, academic support, and so on).
Many institutions store functional class in CLASS_FLD instead of PROGRAM_CODE. VALIDATE which one your chart uses.

when.condition: populated AND linked to a GM award

rules.rationale: Sponsored projects become Grant worktags; the award, not the project, is the Workday anchor.
Capital and internal projects map to the Workday Project worktag.
Gift-funded initiatives tracked as PS projects map to Gift worktags.

then.Location: map to Workday Location or custom worktag

rules.rationale: Operating unit usually means campus or site. VALIDATE: some institutions use it for other purposes.
Rarely used in higher ed. Map to a custom organization only if reporting depends on it.
Institution-specific chartfields become Workday custom organizations or custom worktags. Inventory usage first; many are retired at cutover.
Budget reference is a budget-period concept, not a worktag.
Do not convert PS interunit due-to/due-from lines as ordinary journals. Let Workday intercompany processing generate them.
Statistical amounts (FTE, square feet) load as statistics, not currency.
Never drop an unmapped line. Park it in suspense and route it to the Data Steward.

precedence_and_conflicts: Company (FIN-001) and Ledger Account (FIN-002) are set first and are immutable for the line.
Grant (FIN-011) takes precedence over Project (FIN-012) and Gift (FIN-013) when a PROJECT_ID links to a sponsored award.
If both PROGRAM_CODE and CLASS_FLD are populated, PROGRAM_CODE wins unless the institution sets use_class_fld_for_program = true.
A Gift worktag from FIN-007 (fund-based) and FIN-013 (project-based) must agree; if they differ, route to the error queue.

defaults_and_fallbacks.Cost Center: Use the business unit default cost center only for balance-sheet lines; P&L lines without DEPTID go to suspense.
defaults_and_fallbacks.Program: Balance-sheet lines carry no Program. P&L lines without a program default to institutional_support only if the Data Steward approves.
defaults_and_fallbacks.Fund: No default. Every line must carry a Fund in a fund-accounting tenant.

unmapped_handling.error_queue: unmapped_error_queue (source line id, failing chartfield, value, rule_id)

validation_checks: Every journal line resolves Company and Ledger Account.
Every P&L line resolves Fund, Cost Center, and Program.
Revenue lines carry a Revenue Category; expense lines carry a Spend Category.
Sponsored lines carry a Grant that is active for the line date.
Debits equal credits per Company per journal after conversion.
Converted trial balance ties to PS by Company, Ledger Account, Fund, and period (templates/ps-to-workday/reconciliation/trial_balance_tieout.sql).

hcm_field_rules.when: PS JOB row with ACTION in (HIR, REH)
hcm_field_rules.then: Workday Hire business process (REH as Rehire)

hcm_field_rules.when: PS JOB row with ACTION in (XFR, PRO, DEM, POS)
PS JOB row with ACTION = PAY
PS JOB row with ACTION in (LOA, PLA) / RFL
hcm_field_rules.then: Place Worker on Leave / Return from Leave

hcm_field_rules.when: PS JOB row with ACTION in (TER, RET)
PS JOB row with ACTION = DTA and no field change a Workday process cares about
hcm_field_rules.then: Collapse into the prior event or drop; review volume early
Cost Center assignment; Supervisory Organization from REPORTS_TO
Seed Workday Universal ID from EMPLID so the same person stays one person in Workday Student

student_field_rules.then: Carry over as a Workday FERPA restriction before any other student data is exposed; zero misses allowed
Workday Award Year. PeopleSoft AID_YEAR is the ending year (2026 = 2025-2026).

student_field_rules.when: ISIR records for the current and prior award years
student_field_rules.then: Reload ISIR files from FPS (SAIG) into Workday rather than converting PeopleSoft ISIR rows, so Workday owns a clean transaction chain. Keep PeopleSoft ISIR history in HELIX bronze for audit.
Workday Student SAP Status from the latest evaluation; academic plans load as Workday Academic Plans. Gate: sap_status_carryover_check.sql.

student_field_rules.when: LOAN_ORIGNATN loan type and COD loan ID
student_field_rules.then: Workday Direct Loan Record with the COD loan ID carried unchanged. Never re-originate a loan COD already holds.
Workday Financial Aid Disbursement history for open award years only; closed years stay in the HELIX lakehouse. Gate: disbursement_cod_tieout.sql before the first Workday disbursement.
Open verification records and outstanding checklist items convert as Workday verification records and open action items. Completed verifications carry their completion date and outcome.
